title: Improve Osteoarthritis Care
brief_summary: The purpose of The Improve Osteoarthritis Care study is to improve the quality of osteoarthritis care in Norwegian primary care, by increasing the use of recommended treatment modalities and improving patient access to recommended treatments. The study will use tailored implementation strategies, targeting primary care physicians and physiotherapists to improve knowledge and addressing individual barriers to providing recommended treatments.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Self-reported hip or knee osteoarthritis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Persons who do not understand the Norwegian language
